text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom fell 3.6 percent in early trade on Lisbon bourse on heavy selling by domestic and foreign investors in reaction to the sharp drop of Wall Street yesterday, dealers said.
PT shares fell to 6,051 escudos before recovering to 6,120 escudos, down 160, in turnover of 53,673 at 0956 GMT.
"The market is very nervous. I think that PT will not fall below 6,000 escudos, but we'll have to wait and see how New York opens later," said one operator.

Following the drop by more than five percent in its share price today and yesterday, PT has lost the sharp gains it made since the announcement of its 1996 profits earlier this week and has returned to levels seen at the beginning of March.
PT shares hit a high of 6,650 escudos earlier this week.
